{{Quote|On heavily populated worlds in those sectors, such as Uviuy Exen in Shwuy and Trammen in Harron, every single line squad has been completely armed with light repeating blasters.|A compilation of Imperial documents by Rebel Alliance Major Arhul Hextrophon|<ref name="IS2" />}}
'''Uviuy Exen''' was a heavily populated [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies']] [[Shwuy sector/Legends|Shwuy sector]]. It lay at the intersection of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and [[Shwuy Exchange/Legends|Shwuy Exchange]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]], which led various [[Starship/Legends|starships]] traveling along those routes to pass through the [[Uviuy Exen system/Legends|Uviuy Exen system]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Uviuy Exen remained loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] had become a [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] took place, [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[line squad]]s on the planet were completely armed with [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blasters]]. A few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, Uviuy Exen was the site of [[Battle of Uviuy Exen (6 ABY)|several]] [[Battle of Uviuy Exen (10 ABY)|battles]] between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]].

==Description==
Uviuy Exen was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="IS2" /> located in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Uviuy Exen system/Legends|same name]], a part of the [[Shwuy sector/Legends|Shwuy sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of<ref name="TEA system" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Uviuy Exen lay at the intersection of two [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]<ref name="TEA system" />&mdash;the minor [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route<ref name="PP">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> known as the [[Shwuy Exchange/Legends|Shwuy Exchange]], which connected the planet to the [[Dankayo system/Legends|Dankayo system]], and the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], which linked it to the [[Eeropha system|Eeropha]] and [[Wakeelmui system/Legends|Wakeelmui systems]].<ref name="TEA system" />

Between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]], a number of early hyperlanes connected Uviuy Exen to the systems of [[Chagri system|Chagri]], [[Nouane system/Legends|Nouane]], [[Yabol Opa system/Legends|Yabol Opa]], [[Brentaal system/Legends|Brentaal]], [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant]], and [[Palanhi system/Legends|Palanhi]];<ref name="TEA system" /> however, by [[17,000 BBY]], these had coalesced into a single route running from Chagri to Brentaal through Uviuy Exen.<ref name="EGtW system" /> That hyperlane would eventually be known as the [[Corsin Run]], which had been merged into the modern Hydian Way by [[3694 BBY]].<ref name="TEA system" />

==History==
Although [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding the Uviuy Exen system became well-[[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] and [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]], the planet had already been incorporated into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by 22,000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="TEA system" /> By 17,000 BBY, Uviuy Exen had allied with the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] in its [[First Alsakan Conflict|struggle]] against [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for the status of the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]],<ref name="EGtW system" /> yet it remained in space loyal to the Republic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TEA system" /> Early in that conflict, Uviuy Exen lay at the intersection of territories that the [[First Army|First]], [[Third Mid Rim Army|Third]], and [[Seventh Army|Seventh Armies]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] were tasked with defending against the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="EGtW system" />

[[File:LightRepeater-NEGWT.png|thumb|left|220px|All Imperial Army squads on Uviuy Exen were armed with light repeating blasters.]]
By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Uviuy Exen fell under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="EGtW system" /> and, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], every [[line squad]] of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] on the planet had been completely armed with [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blasters]]. The latter fact was noted by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]] in a compilation of Imperial documents for Alliance [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and other Rebel [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="IS2" /> Uviuy Exen had become an Imperial [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] by the time of the [[Nagai–Tof War|Nagai invasion]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="TEA system" />

The [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|military]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Battle of Uviuy Exen (6 ABY)|defeated]] the [[Zsinj's Empire|forces]] of Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] at Uviuy Exen in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]] as part of a drive to push Imperials up the Hydian Way,<ref name="EGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> and the world had fallen under New Republic control that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. However, [[10 ABY/Legends|four years]] later, [[Battle of Uviuy Exen (10 ABY)|another battle]] was fought in the Uviuy Exen system when Imperials advanced from the Chagri system to the Brentaal system.<ref name="TEA system" />

==Inhabitants==
Uviuy Exen was a heavily populated world by the time the Battle of Yavin took place,<ref name="IS2" /> with the population of its system numbering between 500 million and 1 billion around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].<ref name="TEA system" />

==Behind the scenes==
Uviuy Exen was first mentioned in the [[1989]] ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'', written by [[Greg Gorden]] and published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Uviuy Exen system, and therefore the planet Uviuy Exen, in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEA system" />
